discussion.key_messages: - Dry conditions with valley inversions persisting through the end of the week before valley rain and mountain snow arrive this weekend that will help to mix out the inversions. - Guidance continues to show two more storms next week, but details remain uncertain.

rules_take: Beaver Mountain: the forecasts put <1–8 in. over the next 7 days (middle 2 in.), and they disagree a lot. About 2 in. of that lands in the next 72 hours. The NWS forecasters have 2 in. for the week.
